newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Eastern buys company, issues notes.
newsitem.headline: Eastern buys company, issues notes.

text.p: Eastern Equities Corp said on Thursday it had bought civil works contracting company Renco Tauranga Ltd.
Renco is involved in site development, roading, reticulation and forestry contracting.
Eastern Equities has also acquired a related company, Oropi Quarries Ltd, which owns an Andesite Quarry which is worked for the extraction of aggregate for roading and site development works.
Eastern said following the purchases, it had issued 1.5 million fixed rate convertible notes. The notes have a nominal value of NZ$1 each and an interest rate of 10.8 percent.
Quotation of the convertible notes on the New Zealand Stock Exchange was not being sought.
